payload.claim: The comment "`.git` is stripped before the trailing `/` is read" is attached to the `joel+v0.5.git` case, but that origin (`git@example.com:joel+v0.5.git`) contains no trailing slash at all, so the order-of-stripping claim the comment makes is not what this line exercises. The trailing-slash-vs-`.git` ordering is actually exercised by the earlier `/srv/git/thermal-edge.git/` case in the `forms` list, making this comment read as misplaced for the assertion it precedes.
